title: Synthesis and Structural Characterization of Novel Ytterbium(III) Complexes with both a μ-Oxo Group and Bridged Indenyl Ligands, and Ytterbium(II) Complexes with Bridged Indenyl Ligands

material_class.structural_family: μ-oxo/μ-chloro tetranuclear indenyl ytterbium(III) cluster with [Li(thf)4]+ cations

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, 1,2-bis(indenyl)ethane was added to a toluene solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Yb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3. The mixture was heated at reflux overnight (color change to dark blue; the indenyl ytterbium(III) amide [η5:η5-(CH2)2(C9H6)2]YbN(SiMe3)2 was isolated from this solution as an intermediate). Excess thf was then added and the mixture was heated at reflux for 2 d (color change from dark blue to dark purple). Solvents were removed under vacuum; the residue was washed with n-hexane and extracted with thf. The combined extract was concentrated and cooled to give dark red crystals of 1.
synthesis.temperature: reflux (toluene, overnight then 2 d after thf addition); crystallization at −10 °C
synthesis.time: reflux overnight, then reflux 2 d after thf addition; crystallization for several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: flamed Schlenk-type glassware on a Schlenk line under argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvents pumped off; residue washed with n-hexane (10.0 mL) and extracted with thf (2 × 10.0 mL); combined extract concentrated to about 10.0 mL; dark red crystals obtained at −10 °C

properties.summary: 1H NMR was uninformative because of the lack of locking signals attributed to the strong paramagnetism of Yb(III) complex 1; X-ray analysis confirmed the Yb(III) oxidation state. No susceptibility or other quantitative magnetic data were reported. Crystal color (dark red) is not treated as an optical measurement.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, a toluene solution of Me2Si(C9H7)2 was added slowly to a toluene solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Yb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3. The mixture was stirred and heated at reflux for 6 h. Excess thf was added and reflux was continued for another 24 h (color change to dark red). The solvent was removed under vacuum; the solid was washed with n-hexane and extracted with toluene. Concentration and cooling afforded dark red crystals of 2 (elemental analysis consistent with a toluene solvate).

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, a thf solution of ligand 3, (CH2)2(C9H6SiMe3)2, was added to a thf solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Yb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3. After reflux for 24 h the solvent was evaporated, leaving a red solid. The residue was extracted with n-hexane; concentration and cooling gave red crystals of 4. Coordinated thf and solvated n-hexane can be removed under vacuum according to elemental analysis.

properties.summary: Diamagnetic 1H/13C NMR spectra of 4 are consistent with Yb(II). No quantitative magnetic measurements were reported.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, a dme solution of (CH2)2(C9H6SiMe3)2 was added to a dme solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Yb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3. After reflux for 24 h the solvent was removed, the red solid was washed with n-hexane and extracted with toluene, and cooling of the concentrated extract gave a red crystalline solid of 5. Heating the same Yb amide and ligand in toluene at reflux for 6 h followed by addition of excess dme also produced 5.

properties.summary: 1H NMR showed a 1:1 indenyl:dme ratio; diamagnetism indicates Yb(II). No quantitative magnetic measurements were reported.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, a toluene solution of Me2Si(C9H7)2 was added slowly to a toluene solution of [(Me3Si)2N]3Yb(μ-Cl)Li(thf)3. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 6 h, excess tmeda was added, and the mixture was heated at reflux for 24 h (color change to purple). Solvent was removed, the residue was washed with n-hexane and extracted with toluene, and cooling afforded a purple crystalline solid of 6.

synthesis.procedure: Under argon Schlenk conditions, excess tmeda was added to a toluene solution of the ytterbium(III) amide [η5:η5-(CH2)2(C9H6)2]YbN(SiMe3)2. The mixture was heated at reflux for 24 h (color change from dark blue to red). The solvent was evaporated, the solid was washed with n-hexane and extracted with diethyl ether, and evaporation of the extract afforded 7 as a red solid.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: flamed Schlenk-type glassware on a Schlenk line under argon

properties.summary: Formation of Yb(II) complex 7 from a Yb(III) amide plus tmeda is consistent with one-electron reductive elimination; 1H NMR was obtained. No quantitative magnetic measurements were reported.
